final_message:
**Status:** Reproduced (simulated Windows: reproduced on Linux by having more fixable files than the process's open-file limit)

**Expected:** `eslint src --fix` fixes every file with auto-fixable problems and exits 0.

**Actual:** ESLint crashes with `EMFILE: too many open files, open '.../src/f1902.js'` (exit code 2), with the same stack as the report: `fs.writeFile` inside `Promise.all`, called from `ESLint.outputFixes` (`lib/eslint/eslint.js:533`) and `cli.js:637`. Only about as many files as the fd limit allows are fixed (1004 of 3000 at `ulimit -n 1024`); the rest are left unfixed.

**Trigger:** More files with fixable problems than the process's open-file limit. `outputFixes` starts a `writeFile` for every result at once, so all the opens are queued before any file is closed. 500 files at a limit of 1024 passes. 3000 files at 1024 fails. Each file here is `var a = 1` / `var b = 2` / `console.log(a, b)`, with `semi`, `no-var` and `prefer-const` enabled.

**Run:** `./repro/emfile-fix.sh` from the repo root. It builds the files in a temp dir, runs `bin/eslint.js src --fix` under `ulimit -n 1024`, and exits 1 if eslint fails or any file is left unfixed. Setting `EMFILE_LIMIT=none FILES=21000` keeps this machine's own limit of 20000, with no ulimit change. It fails the same way (`Promise.all (index 19980)`, 1020 of 21000 files fixed), taking about 70 s.

**Passes when:** I swapped `outputFixes` for a throwaway version that writes in batches of 100 files, then reverted it. The check exited 0 for both the 3000-file run at limit 1024 and the 21000-file run at the default limit. It also passes unmodified with 500 files.

**Artifacts:** `/work/runs/e512745906/repo/repro/emfile-fix.sh` (the check). No production code was changed (`git status` shows only `repro/`).

The conditions differ from the report. I ran ESLint 9.30.1 (this checkout), not 9.28.0, on Node 22.22.0 on Linux, not Node 22.11.0 on Windows. The report's `Promise.all (index 8189)` fits Windows' roughly 8192 open-file limit, but I did not test on Windows.

**Likely cause:** `ESLint.outputFixes` in `lib/eslint/eslint.js` has no cap on concurrent writes.
patch:
diff --git a/repro/emfile-fix.sh b/repro/emfile-fix.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..1758475
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro/emfile-fix.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Check for: `eslint --fix` fails with "EMFILE: too many open files" when many files
+# have fixable problems (ESLint.outputFixes writes every fixed file via one Promise.all).
+#
+# Expected: all files are fixed and eslint exits 0.
+# Exits non-zero while the bug is present, zero when it is fixed.
+#
+# Env:
+#   FILES        number of files with fixable problems (default 3000)
+#   EMFILE_LIMIT soft open-file limit applied to the eslint process (default 1024;
+#                set to "none" to keep the machine's own limit and raise FILES above it)
+set -u
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+FILES="${FILES:-3000}"
+EMFILE_LIMIT="${EMFILE_LIMIT:-1024}"
+
+work="$(mktemp -d /tmp/eslint-emfile.XXXXXX)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+mkdir "$work/src"
+
+for i in $(seq 1 "$FILES"); do
+	printf 'var a = 1\nvar b = 2\nconsole.log(a, b)\n' > "$work/src/f$i.js"
+done
+
+cat > "$work/eslint.config.js" <<'CFG'
+module.exports = [
+	{
+		files: ["**/*.js"],
+		rules: { semi: "error", "no-var": "error", "prefer-const": "error" },
+	},
+];
+CFG
+
+cd "$work"
+if [ "$EMFILE_LIMIT" != "none" ]; then
+	ulimit -n "$EMFILE_LIMIT" || { echo "could not set ulimit -n $EMFILE_LIMIT" >&2; exit 99; }
+fi
+echo "open-file limit: $(ulimit -n), files with fixable problems: $FILES"
+
+node "$repo_root/bin/eslint.js" src --fix > eslint.out 2> eslint.err
+status=$?
+
+unfixed=$(grep -L '^const b = 2;$' "$work"/src/f*.js | wc -l)
+
+echo "eslint exit code: $status"
+echo "files still unfixed: $unfixed of $FILES"
+if [ -s eslint.err ]; then
+	echo "--- eslint stderr ---"
+	head -n 12 eslint.err
+fi
+
+if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$unfixed" -ne 0 ]; then
+	echo "FAIL: eslint --fix did not fix all files cleanly"
+	exit 1
+fi
+echo "PASS: all files fixed"
